svg.title: TwinCAT polling + Sum Read: observed batch costs
svg.text: TwinCAT polling + Sum Read: observed batch costs
90 measured runs, 9 configurations; 1 ms PLC task. Points: means; crosses: P95.
Teal: at least 20 samples per size; grey: sparse bins. Samples within runs are correlated.
Natural batches, not controlled size probes. No extrapolation to 128/255-event reads.
